messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — proposing a soft-freeze for MVP features EOD Friday to lock launch lanes. Critical bugs and unblock PRs OK, but no new feature surface area after freeze.
alex: I support the freeze. Need a clear emergency exceptions flow for pilot-driven blockers so sales/CS can escalate.
maya: Draft process: create a 'scope-exception' card on the project board, PM sign-off, engineering oncall approval, and include a rollback plan. Exceptions consume the late-feature budget.
chris: We had too many small additions last sprint. Can we formalize the late-feature budget?
maya: Proposal: reserve 10 dev-days for late MVP work. Anything beyond that must be pushed to v1 or swapped with a cut from the cutlist.
liz: Sales update: two pilots — Customer A needs tenant SSO for onboarding next month; Customer B is asking for audit logs but can defer. Customer A might delay without SSO.
sam: If SSO is blocking the pilot, it might qualify as an exception, but SSO looks non-trivial.
alex: Rough eng estimate for SSO (integration + infra + tests) ~12 dev-days. That exceeds our 10d buffer.
maya: Options: 1) Approve SSO as a scope-exception and move a mid-priority item to v1; 2) Offer an ops-assisted SSO workaround for the pilot (SAML proxy + manual onboarding); 3) Delay the pilot and allocate SSO to v1.
chris: Ops-assisted path seems viable short-term. We'd need a runbook, a small admin UI tweak, and telemetry to track manual onboarding.
maya: Can engineering and ops deliver an ops-assisted SSO for Customer A to avoid rebaselining?
liz: Customer A accepts an ops-assisted approach if onboarding turnaround is <48 hours and we provide clear docs.
alex: Engineering caveat: ops-assisted requires a temporary bypass and a one-off script — estimate 3 dev-days + 2 QA days. That fits inside the 10d buffer.
maya: OK let's lock the ops-assisted workaround. I'll publish the soft-freeze policy and exception template.
chris: UX owners — please prepare the admin invite copy, a small warning banner during ops-assist, and a telemetry event for pilot onboarding.
sam: Milestone tracker update: label SSO as 'pilot-workaround' and add SSO to the v1 backlog with tag 'pilot-driven' so it doesn't get lost.
maya: I'll file the milestone ticket. Suggested ticket body:
- Title: Pilot SSO — ops-assisted -> v1 backlog
- Decision: ops-assisted SSO for pilot (manual onboarding + runbook)
- Owners: alex (eng), ops (setup), chris (UX), liz (customer PM)
- Rollout plan: manual for first 2 pilots, then automate
- Rebaseline rule: SSO moved to v1 unless additional days are funded
alex: Add a guardrail: if more than 2 scope-exceptions are approved, trigger a 2-week milestone reset review to reassess scope/timeline.
maya: Agreed. I'll add that contingency to the policy and schedule a short meeting Friday 4pm PT to approve the final freeze list and exception guardrails.
liz: I'll communicate the ops-assisted plan to the pilot and set expectations.
chris: +1 on the meeting; I'll bring the UX checklist and mock copy.
oncall-bot: Reminder: Friday 4:00pm PT — "MVP soft-freeze approval" in #product. Attendees: maya, alex, chris, liz, sam.
maya: Thanks everyone. I'll post the freeze doc with the cutlist and the exception template by EOD tomorrow.
